packet:
Opening (Comet Catcher, our start B8, Armada vehicles). The commander runs its build list: home extractors (spot_67, spot_74, spot_73, spot_68), three solars, the plant, then it stays at the plant helping it, out only for one solar or one extractor at a time. The commander never chases a scout car or a Tick; it attacks a raider party at a building of ours within its short walk, and never goes past spot_69 or spot_62.

plant: builds its list in order (constructor, Rovers, constructor, Blitzes). It is never idle. It is the only factory until I say otherwise.

constructors: expansion is their job. Spots in this order, nearest first: spot_68, spot_62, spot_69, spot_63, spot_61, spot_54, spot_64, spot_76, spot_71, spot_52, spot_50, spot_45, spot_43, spot_59. A light turret (armllt) beside spot_69, spot_63, spot_64, spot_71 and spot_52 once their extractor stands; a light turret at the plant the moment the first enemy armflea or armpw is in the picture. Energy: one solar when the energy line reads STALLING and the metal store holds 150 or more; otherwise no solar. Never go east of spot_71 or spot_59.

Rovers (armfav): two stay at home, near spot_69, and attack any armflea, armpw or armfav at our extractors; the others scout.

Blitzes (armflash): gather at spot_69 until they are a group; a lone enemy raider at an extractor is met by one or two Blitzes from the nearest group, never the whole group.

Comet Catcher, our start B8, Armada vehicles. His base is north-east: his commander, a radar and a light turret were seen at spot_25 (H3); a beamer, a radar and eight armpw at spot_35 and spot_27 (F4-G4). plant: its list. It is never idle. The new plant at spot_68: its list.

A constructor with an armpw near it drives to the nearest Blitzes or turret and goes back to work when the armpw is dead or gone. Never east of spot_78, spot_58, spot_49 or spot_21.

group_V1 (the big group of Blitzes): the raid on his northern extractors, spending our army lead. Comet Catcher, our start B8, Armada vehicles. His base is north-east: his commander, a radar and a light turret were seen at spot_25 (H3); light turrets at spot_20, spot_27, spot_51; his armrock and armwar party (party_32) at spot_32 (E4). His armpw parties walk into our middle spots; they are met by our pickets.

commander: stays at the plant helping it. When an armpw or armflea party comes within its short walk of home or the plant, it attacks it. It never chases and never goes past spot_69 or spot_62.

plant: its list. It is never idle. The plant at spot_68: its list. The Advanced Vehicle Plant at avp_yard is built first of everything at home: constructors at home help it until it stands.

constructors: expansion is their job, each on its own list or, without one, the nearest free spot of: spot_47, spot_44, spot_31, spot_33, spot_49, spot_37, spot_19, spot_26, spot_24, spot_21, spot_9, spot_4, spot_14, spot_7, spot_2. Every lost extractor is rebuilt as soon as the raider is gone. A light turret beside every extractor that has none. Nobody builds inside a plant's exit lane. A constructor with an armpw near it drives to the nearest Blitzes or turret and goes back to work when the armpw is dead or gone. Never east of spot_78, spot_58, spot_49 or spot_21.

group_W2 and group_O3 (the middle body): they are one body; group_O3 joins group_W2. Against party_32 (armrock and armwar at spot_32) they fight together, all of them at once, never one part alone; while they are apart, the part nearer the party steps back toward spot_47 until the other is beside it. Their station is spot_47. They cover spot_59, spot_56, spot_58, spot_52, spot_47, spot_49, spot_46, spot_44, spot_37, spot_31, spot_33, spot_63, spot_64, spot_66, spot_71, spot_78: they attack any armpw party there with the whole body and come back to spot_47 after. Never east of spot_46 or spot_37.

group_T2 (the Stouts and Janus, and every new Stout, Janus and Blitz that is not in another group; it never joins group_W2): the northern guard, station spot_36, gathering there. group_V1 (the hurt Blitzes): holds at home beside the plant, guarding home and the avp_yard.

Rovers: scouts, left to themselves.

packet:
Comet Catcher, our start B8, Armada vehicles. His base is north-east: his commander, a radar and a light turret were seen at spot_25 (H3); an Overwatch heavy turret at spot_27 (F4), light turrets at spot_20, spot_51. His army (party_32: an armmav Gunslinger, an armfido Hound, armwar and more) stands at spot_33 and spot_31 (D4). He is going tier 2.

commander: stays at the plant helping it. When an armpw or armflea party comes within its short walk of home or the plant, it attacks it. It never chases and never goes past spot_69 or spot_62.

plant: its list, never idle. The plant at spot_68: Blitzes. The Advanced Vehicle Plant: its list.

constructors: each on its own list; without one, the nearest free spot of: spot_47, spot_44, spot_56, spot_58, spot_19, spot_26, spot_24, spot_9, spot_4, spot_7, spot_2. Every lost extractor is rebuilt as soon as the raider is gone. Nobody stands or builds inside a plant's exit lane. A constructor with an enemy near it drives back toward our army or a turret and goes back to work when it is gone. No constructor goes to spot_31, spot_33, spot_37 or spot_21 while party_32 stands there.

group_V1, group_H5 and group_I5 are one army, the Stouts, Janus and Blitzes of the middle. None of them attacks party_32 alone. All three gather at spot_38 until they stand there together; then all three attack party_32 at once, every soldier, the Janus and Stouts in front, the Blitzes closing on the armfido and armmav. When party_32 is dead, all three advance together along spot_33, spot_37, spot_20, spot_18, spot_29, spot_25, spot_17; his commander, when seen, is attacked by every soldier until it dies.

group_I4 (the Bull, Stouts and Blitzes at home, and every new unit from the plants): walks to spot_38 and joins the army there.

Rovers: scouts, left to themselves.

packet:
Comet Catcher, our start B8, Armada vehicles. His base is found: his Bot Lab (armlab) stands at his_lab (H1, beside spot_5), with an Overwatch (armhlt) at spot_10 (G2), a Beamer near spot_5 (G2), and flak and nanos at spot_12 (H2). Gauntlets (armguard, reach 1220) stand at spot_41 (F5) and spot_27 (F4): no constructor works within their reach.

commander: stays at the plant helping it. When an armpw or armflea party comes within its short walk of home, the plant or solar_field, it attacks it. It never chases far and never goes past spot_69 or spot_62.

plants: their lists, never idle. The Bot Lab, when it stands: armrectr only.

constructors: each on its own list; without one: the nearest free spot of spot_7, spot_14, spot_21, spot_23, spot_19, spot_26, spot_9, spot_47, spot_79, spot_75, then spot_46, spot_49, spot_32 once the Gauntlet at spot_41 is dead. Never to spot_6, spot_5, spot_10, spot_3, spot_11, spot_29, spot_18, spot_27, spot_40, spot_41, spot_46, spot_49 or anything east of spot_20 while the Gauntlets stand. Every lost extractor is rebuilt as soon as the raider is gone. Nobody stands or builds inside a plant's exit lane. A constructor with an enemy near it or under fire from something unseen drives back toward our army or a turret and goes back to work when it is clear.

The Rovers (armfav) from plant_13472 are the home guard against armflea: they stay at home and at solar_field and attack every armflea party in our half on sight. group_B10 holds at spot_68.

group_L5 (our main army, in his base): it ignores every party behind it, never chases an armflea, armpw or armrectr, and never walks toward spot_40 or spot_27. It advances together along spot_17, spot_12, his_lab, spot_5, spot_10, spot_6, in that order, killing his Bot Lab (armlab), his constructors (armack) and every building there; its Mausers shell the Overwatch and Beamer from out of their reach while the Stouts and Bulls go in as one body. It goes to the next place the moment it reaches one. It never falls back while it outweighs what it meets, never walks home, never splits off detachments. His commander (armcom), when seen, is attacked by every soldier until it dies.

group_O8 (the second army, 50 strong): its walk home is wrong and abandoned; it never walks home and never answers armflea. It gathers at spot_47, then advances along spot_49, spot_46, then spot_41 and spot_40, together, and kills the Gauntlet (armguard) and every turret standing at spot_41 and spot_40; then it advances to spot_55 and spot_53 and kills his extractors there; then it stands at spot_46 and kills any enemy party that comes to our extractors between spot_37, spot_44, spot_47, spot_49 and spot_46. New groups from plant_28554, plant_10155 and plant_28375 join group_O8.

Other Rovers: scouts, left to themselves.
